rdfs:label: ownerOf
rdfs:comment: A pod or resource the agent owns — the inverse of `owner`.
notes: Deprecated: `solid:ownerOf` does not exist in the Solid terms vocabulary (http://www.w3.org/ns/solid/terms defines only `solid:owner`), so this term has no upstream mapping. Instead, assert `urn:solid:owner` (solid:owner) on the storage, pointing at the owner's WebID — note that is the inverse direction, so it is not a drop-in replacement. To list a user's pods from their WebID, use `urn:solid:storage` (pim:storage).

history.note: Deprecated: solid:ownerOf does not exist upstream; removed owl:sameAs, domain -> Agent; use urn:solid:owner (inverse) or urn:solid:storage.
